sources.notes: OpenSPP 2 (Odoo 19) modules; spp_api_v2* hold the FastAPI routers the REST API v2 is built from

notes: Adaptor 4.x calls the OpenSPP REST API v2 (spp_api_v2, FastAPI, base path /api/v2/spp) with OAuth 2.0 client credentials; records are addressed by external identifier system|value. Up to 3.x the adaptor used the Odoo external API (XML-RPC) via odoo-await.
